title: Physical Therapy Foundations
definition: PT restores movement through exercise, manual therapy, and modalities — after surgery, stroke, or injury. Evaluation finds the specific impairment; treatment targets it precisely. Movement is the medicine.
patient_flow: Referrals arrive from surgery, neurology, and medicine; therapists evaluate strength, mobility, and function within 24 hours. Goals are set with the patient — walk to the bathroom, return to work. Daily sessions progress through the gym, pool, and real-life practice rooms until discharge home with a home program and follow-up.
code_demo:
def fim_progress(admission_scores, discharge_scores):
    """Functional Independence Measure change: 18 items, 1-7 each."""
    gain = sum(discharge_scores) - sum(admission_scores)
    return f"FIM gain: {gain} points ({sum(admission_scores)} -> {sum(discharge_scores)}). MCID ~22 for stroke rehab."
print(fim_progress([3]*18, [5]*18))
teaching: Simple: the core idea in plain words — what it is and why it matters.
